title: 第十三章 侯门弃子那又如何第十四章 我看你不顺眼
lines: “成功了。”
黄良一蹦三尺高，情不自禁地欢呼起来。
圣女和长老们都忍不住松了一口气，过了九十九道石阶，就可以龙门留名了，再次也是第一丈，那也是龙门榜上的天才了。
“天啊，他真的冲上去了，看起来一点力气都不费。”
“一跃九阶，太牛逼了，天才，绝对的天才。”
“到底是谁传出来的消息，说侯门弃子是废物。”
广场上一片欢呼，这是历史性的一刻，标志着太玄宗有资格参加百宗大比。
“安静一些，不要打扰他。”
易扶摇开口。
人们这才反应过来，林昊只是踏上了石阶，还没有真正开始跃龙门。
上万道目光齐刷刷的落在龙门下的少年背影上，所有人心中都在猜测，这个身上承载着太玄宗希望的年轻人，到底能跃到龙门几丈。
龙门下，林昊近距离感受龙门的磁场，体内至尊神脉躁动得更加剧烈，他的肉身在重力下不断被淬炼，第八条神脉，隐约有开启的迹象。
“龙门的重力可以对至尊神脉进行滋养，隐约间，我竟能感受到龙门内天道气息的一丝契合。”
林昊此刻心情极好，至尊体就是一个宝藏，等待自己不断去开发，他有一种直觉，当九条至尊神脉全部开启的时候，一定会给自己带来意想不到的好处。
随后，林昊抬起头，锐利的目光直接落在龙门第九丈那片区域，最终落在那个对他来说有着特殊意义的名字上。
没错，那是他的目标。
那个名字之下的区域，林昊没看一眼。
只有九丈的最巅峰，才是他的目标，唯一的目标。
压力如潮，林昊活动一下筋骨，单腿后侧，前腿弯曲，身如弓。
这一刻，他眸若金灯，眼神坚毅，目光所指，第九丈！
“他开始蓄力了。”
任百川激动地搓手，整个广场鸦雀无声，所有人都在注视着，等待着，期待着。
嗖！
林昊动了，他如一条苍龙，扶摇而上，整个人化为一道光，像是要冲入九霄。
在一道道惊骇目光注视下，林昊一跃九丈高，在第九丈中间的位置停了下来，他眼神所及，正是林寒的名字。
“天啊，他跃上了龙门九丈。”
只是这一刹那，整个太玄宗彻底炸锅了。
龙门九丈，那是什么概念。
整个大夏，九丈龙门上，只有四个人，那是真正的盖世天骄，无一不是世家子弟。
关键是，林昊只是开脉境，九丈上的那些，跃龙门的时候，哪一个不是气海境，甚至更高。
普通开脉境，莫说在龙门磁场影响下，即便只是平地起跳，也到不了这个位置。
今日，太玄宗这个即将被除名的云川小宗门，竟出现了九丈天骄。
这预示着什么？
已经不言而喻了。
“他达到了林寒的位置，同等位置。”
“谁言侯门弃子，又是谁在说天生废材。”
“不对，你们看，他还在蓄力，他身体悬空，竟然能二次发力。”
“天啊，他要干什么，要破林寒纪录吗？他只有开脉境，无法飞行，一跃而起，竟能中途再次发力，这是如何做到的。”
九丈中间位置，还没完。
content_en:
"Successful."
Huang Liang jumped three feet high and couldn't help cheering.
The saint and the elders couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief. After passing the ninety-nine stone steps, they could leave their names in the Dragon Gate. Once again, they were the first one, and they were also the geniuses on the Dragon Gate list.
"Oh my gosh, he really went up there and it didn't look like he had any effort at all."
"One jump to nine levels, that's awesome, a genius, an absolute genius."
"Who on earth spread the news that Hou Men's abandoned son is a waste."
There were cheers in the square. This was a historic moment, marking Taixuanzong's qualification to participate in the Hundred Sects Competition.
"Be quiet and don't disturb him."
Yi Fuyao spoke.
Only then did people realize that Lin Hao had only stepped onto the stone steps and had not actually started jumping over the Dragon Gate yet.
Tens of thousands of eyes fell on the back of the young man under the dragon gate. Everyone was guessing how many feet this young man who carried the hope of Taixuan Sect could jump to the dragon gate.
Under the dragon's gate, Lin Hao felt the magnetic field of the dragon's gate at close range. The supreme divine vein in his body became more violent. His body was continuously tempered under gravity, and there were vague signs of opening of the eighth divine vein.
"The gravity of the Dragon Gate can nourish the Supreme Divine Vein. Vaguely, I can actually feel a trace of the aura of heaven in the Dragon Gate."
Lin Hao was in a very good mood at the moment. The Supreme Body was a treasure waiting for him to continue to develop. He had an intuition that when all nine Supreme Divine Veins were opened, it would definitely bring him unexpected benefits.
Then, Lin Hao raised his head, and his sharp eyes fell directly on the area nine feet away from the dragon gate, and finally landed on the name that had special meaning to him.
Yes, that was his goal.
Lin Hao didn't glance at the area under that name.
Only the highest peak of Jiuzhang is his goal, the only goal.
The pressure was like a tide. Lin Hao moved his muscles and bones, bending the back of one leg and the front leg, and his body was like a bow.
At this moment, his eyes were like golden lamps, his eyes were firm, and his gaze was pointing at nine feet!
"He's starting to gain momentum."
Ren Baichuan rubbed his hands excitedly, and the whole square was silent. Everyone was watching, waiting, and expecting.
Whoosh!
Lin Hao moved. He was like a blue dragon, soaring up. His whole body turned into a ray of light, as if he was about to rush into the sky.
Under the gazes of horrified eyes, Lin Hao jumped nine feet high and stopped in the middle of the nine feet. What he looked at was Lin Han's name.
"Oh my god, he jumped ninety feet up the dragon gate."
Just at this moment, the entire Taixuan Sect was completely blown away.
The dragon gate is nine feet long, what kind of concept is that?
In the entire Daxia, there are only four people on Jiuzhang Longmen. They are truly unparalleled talents, and all of them are children of aristocratic families.
The key is that Lin Hao is only in the Pulse Opening Realm, and among those on Jiuzhang, when he leaps over the Dragon Gate, which one is not the Qi Sea Realm, or even higher.
In the ordinary pulse opening state, not to mention under the influence of the Longmen magnetic field, even if you just jump from the ground, you will not reach this position.
Today, Taixuan Sect, a small sect in Yunchuan that is about to be expelled, has a nine-foot-long genius.
What does this portend?
It goes without saying.
"He has reached Lin Han's position, the same position."
"Whoever said that the noble family abandoned his son is also saying that he was born a waste."
"No, look, he is still accumulating power. His body is suspended in the air, and he can actually exert power a second time."
"Oh my God, what is he going to do? Is he going to break Lin Han's record? He only has the Pulse Opening state and can't fly. He jumped up and was able to exert force again in the middle. How did he do it?"
…………
The middle position of Jiuzhang is not finished yet.
